profile.headline: Software Engineer at Booz Allen Hamilton

positions.title: Student Consultant
positions.description:
Through the University of Maryland QUEST Honors Program, created integrated database, data analytics, and user interface to enable dynamic real-time investment decisions in the electrical power generation and distribution segment

Led creation of tool that integrates multiple datasets and analysis of user input using Ruby

Performed statistical analysis and data analysis with linear regressions and decision trees using R

positions.title: Strategic Innovation Group Intern
positions.description:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d-848xvboVk

Participated in the Second annual Booz Allen Hamilton Strategic Innovation Group Games.

With intern team, created web application I-3City, a proof of concept of a framework that performs predictive analytics. i-3 City represents the predictive data geospatially and through dynamic visualizations based off user input.

Worked in JavaScript, Java, HTML, and CSS.

positions.title: Database Management Assistant
positions.description:
Supported Dr. David Gill, Ph.D, in his research on the effectiveness of marine protected areas. Developed SQL database with 25 fields to track environmental data for 500+ marine protected areas. 

Worked in R and worked with R studio.
